messages:
Alice Park: Heads up — Pershing St is basically a river right now. Bike lane flooded past the Market St crossover. Anyone trying to commute southbound? :bike::sweat_drops:
Samir Patel: Just rode through, had to dismount and push for two blocks. Shoes soaked. My dryer is filing for unemployment. :grimacing:
Jules Nguyen: Yikes. Switched to N‑Judah + walk—train's slow but at least dry. 10–12 min delay.
Zoë Martins: Photo: https://imgur.com/abc123 — that curb looks underwater. Saw a DPW truck near Embarcadero. @DPW-Dispatch FYI.
MuniBot: Service alert: N‑Judah delays ~12 min due to wet rails. See https://muni.status/alerts/548
Samir Patel: Anyone heading past 3rd & Bryant and have room for one soggy cyclist? @carpooling
Alice Park: Thinking WFH tomorrow if this keeps up. Also — does anyone have a spare size 9 waterproof shoe in Lost & Found? :pray:
Jules Nguyen: I have a pair of galoshes in my locker, size 9. Can drop them off. :thumbsup:
Zoë Martins: Quick poll — walk it, Muni, carpool, or WFH? React with 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣ or 4️⃣
WeatherBot: Flash flood warning issued until 18:45. Avoid low‑lying roads. Stay safe everyone. :umbrella:
Alice Park: Thanks — staying flexible. If you see any photos of the 2nd St underpass tag #flood-watch so we can warn others.
Samir Patel: Tagged and headed to a coffee shop to dry off. ☕️
